metadata.title: Cicd debounce cron - Reduce complexity of CI/CD build to simplify / shorten the build cycle and eliminate duplicate jobs.
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description: Reduce complexity of CI/CD build to simplify / shorten the build cycle and eliminate duplicate jobs.

commits.message:
chore(ci): optimize GitHub Actions — reduce redundancy, add guardrails

- Add concurrency groups with cancel-in-progress to all 20 workflows
  so rapid pushes only run the latest build per branch
- Skip draft PRs via job-level `if:` condition on all workflow jobs
- Add `types: [opened, synchronize, ready_for_review]` to PR triggers
  so marking a draft ready triggers a fresh run
- Add path filters to 14 workflows that previously triggered on every
  push regardless of what changed (docs-only PRs now trigger zero builds)
- Add timeout-minutes to 18 workflows that lacked them (was only 2/20)
- Standardize all workflows to Python 3.12, remove 3.10/3.11 matrices
- Merge lint.yml and lint-plugins.yml into a single workflow using a
  target: [mcpgateway, plugins] matrix dimension (delete lint-plugins.yml)
- Strip duplicated linting from full-build-pipeline.yml (flake8,
  interrogate, pylint, lint-web, verify all covered by dedicated workflows);
  keep only unique steps: formatting check, SRI verify, smoketest
- Remove duplicate bandit from full-build-pipeline (standalone bandit.yml)
- Restrict linting-full.yml to push-to-main only (individual lint
  workflows cover PRs; pre-commit re-runs the same linters)
- Reduce rust-plugins.yml matrix on PRs: ubuntu-only instead of
  3-OS cross-platform (full matrix still runs on push to main)

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
chore(ci): remove redundant workflows, schedules, and dead files

- Delete full-build-pipeline.yml — formatting check, linting, and smoke
  tests are fully covered by lint.yml, linting-full.yml, and playwright.yml;
  move its unique sri-verify step into linting-full.yml
- Remove weekly cron schedules from bandit, dependency-review,
  license-check, docker-multiplatform, and docker-scan — all already
  trigger on push/PR so the weekly runs were pure duplication;
  workflow_dispatch remains for manual runs
- Delete 9 stale .yml.inactive files: asynctest, check-headers, devskim,
  google-cloud-run (2), osv-scanner, release-chart, snyk, tox

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
chore(ci): add GHCR cleanup script and workflow (inactive)

- Rewrite .github/tools/cleanup-ghcr-versions.sh with pattern-based tag
  protection (latest, v*, semver), age-based retention (KEEP_DAYS),
  month filtering (MONTH), and max-delete limit (MAX_DELETE) for
  incremental cleanup
- Add wave-based rate limiting (30 deletes/wave, 10s pause) to stay
  within GitHub API secondary rate limits
- Add .github/workflows/ghcr-cleanup.yml.inactive — weekly scheduled
  cleanup workflow using only gh CLI (no third-party actions); rename
  to .yml to activate
- Add .github/tools/CLEANUP.md with usage examples

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
